verdict.rationale: Egnyte is a content-collaboration SaaS platform, so API-based user and group administration is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no user provisioning API, group management endpoints or admin API. SSO/AD integration and workflow webhooks are adjacent features, not documented admin automation endpoints.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the team is manageable by API — member provisioning, group management, and admin endpoints documented for automation
